context: Reference focused cleanup: identity key and value mappers in Collectors.toMap should use Function.identity without changing collector semantics.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 17-compatible StateIndexes code and adds any required java.util.function.Function import.

checklist.name: Uses Function.identity for identity key mapper
checklist.description: Replaces state -> state with Function.identity() in the normalized state counting collector.

checklist.name: Uses Function.identity for identity value mapper
checklist.description: Replaces card -> card with Function.identity() in the Card::id indexing collector.

checklist.name: Preserves merge functions

checklist.name: Preserves map suppliers

checklist.name: Does not over-apply identity

checklist.name: Keeps downstream result behavior
